name: Cursed Strikes lengthens Rotclaw and Hypovolemic Shock (#1784)
contract: Cursed Strikes ships two ranks, 300982 and 301363, each one effect: aura 108 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50% (rank 1) and 99 + 1 = +100% (rank 2), over EffectSpellClassMask (1048576, 512, 0) = word 0 bit 20 Hypovolemic Shock (572305, 572409-572412) and word 1 bit 9 Rotclaw (503476-503486, 804197) - exactly the two spells the tooltip names. Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION. Rotclaw has DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms and Hypovolemic Shock DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms. Tooltip: "Increases the duration of Rotclaw and Hypovolemic Shock by $s1%." The first rank is unlearned before the second so the two modifiers never coexist. Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Rotclaw keeps its authored 4000 ms before the talent
Hypovolemic Shock keeps its authored 15000 ms before the talent
Cursed Strikes does not touch Bloodbolt's duration
